title: lint: nits from the Seeds and actions family's contract review (#37807: body mask remainders, fence test spelling, objectName global, flow node coverage, two write-call readings)
body:
repo:objectstack#6 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjQkY5yXZrN9BEA3rEK

Filing gate: ③ follow-up of an accepted delivery. Nits left open by contract review PASS on PR #37807 (card #35143, Seeds and actions family; records 7209862537, 7211486008 and the head record). None affects correctness or the contract. N3 (ADR-0141 D1 / docs binding list) is already on #37815.

- N1 — the action-body mask (`validate-action-body-capabilities.ts`) has two remainders its header does not list: a nested template literal inside `${ }` (inner text read as code) and a regex literal holding a quote (rest of the line read inverted); a parameter that shadows a bound alias is not counted by `boundOnce`. List them in the header or close them.
- N4 — `runtime-gate.inert-type-writes.test.ts` spells the suite's member filter and its `['flow']` default a second time instead of asking the suite's dispatch.
- N5 — `ActionSchema.objectName` admits the literal `global` (`action-governance.ts:76-84`); written out it is now refused at the `action` door as an unknown object (as `defineStack` already refuses it). No producer writes it; decide whether to exempt it or retire the spelling.
- N6 — the flow-node site reads `config.objectName` on five node types; other node types and the legacy `config.object` spelling are not read (a miss, never a false finding).
- N7 — the extractor's write-call reading (`packages/cli/src/utils/extract-hook-body.ts`) and lint's (`validate-action-body-writes.ts`) are two spellings in two packages tied only by their own pins; one shared source would close it.

Suggested-grade: p3 · polish on a landed check.
Dedupe: `boundOnce`, `config.object flow node lint`, `objectName global action door` found only #35143 and PR #37807.
